canonicalReason: Trust order manufacturer page for exact product > pack photo > GTIN-matched retailer. The haskbeauty.com page (current 'Repair + Argan Oil Shampoo') is the manufacturer source; it is the same 473 ml / 16 fl oz line as shown on the pack photo, although it shows no GTIN itself. Its list is identical item for item and in order to the GTIN-matched dm.de list (GTIN 071164341469) and to every legible fragment of the back-label pack photo, so the three sources corroborate each other and the list is taken verbatim from the manufacturer page (25 items, case/punctuation kept; synonym entries such as 'Aqua/Water/Eau' and 'Parfum/Fragrance' are single items as published).
normalization: Runbook step 2: canonical list items lower-cased, trimmed, whitespace collapsed, joined with '|', SHA-256; split synonym entries (e.g. 'Aqua (Water, Eau)') merged before numbering.
